papers.title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
papers.summary: Shows how a small 'student' model can be trained to copy a big 'teacher' model's soft answers, making AI models cheap enough to deploy on devices like phones.

papers.title: A Survey on Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: A broad survey of how LLMs are tested: what to evaluate (reasoning, medicine, ethics and more), which benchmarks exist, and how to score results.
